theme: Axon guidance by netrin, semaphorin, Slit-Robo and ephrin cues
core_role: The shared pathways are the netrin and Sema3A-plexin guidance-cue signalling that steers axon extension and repulsion, the core cue-receptor axis alongside which Slit-Robo, ephrin and Rho-GTPase growth-cone collapse machinery complete axon pathfinding.

theme: Innate mucosal defence against bacterial attachment and invasion
core_role: The shared pathways frame antimicrobial host defence at epithelial surfaces (metal sequestration, agglutination, killing of Gram-positive bacteria, control of bacterial attachment and entry), here as the host side of the bacterial invasion exemplified by Listeria's actin-driven entry.

theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell transcriptional signatures and lymphoid activation modules that mark the B lineage, read here as the cellular starting point for germinal-centre maturation into memory B cells and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells.

theme: Mevalonate-derived isoprenoid, sterol and quinone biosynthesis
core_role: The shared pathways are the mevalonate/isoprenoid and cholesterol biosynthesis route, framed here as the source of prenyl (farnesyl, geranylgeranyl) units that also feed ubiquinone and vitamin K/menaquinone metabolism used for gamma-carboxylation of proteins.

theme: Pre-mRNA splicing and snRNA biogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways name the spliceosome and its regulation plus snRNA cap hypermethylation, i.e. the core splicing machinery and snRNP maturation that the additional snRNA transcription and spliceosome assembly steps build up and regulate.

theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability, decay and translation
core_role: The shared pathways are the cytoplasmic mRNA turnover machinery (deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, P-bodies, 3'-UTR-mediated stabilization), serving here as the effector decay and stabilization step through which ARE-binding proteins and miRNA/siRNA silencing regulate gene expression.

theme: Immune tolerance through T cell suppression and Treg induction
core_role: The shared pathways describe negative regulation of effector T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine/IFN-gamma production together with promotion of regulatory T cell differentiation, i.e. the inhibitory immune-checkpoint arm acting on TCR engagement and co-stimulation by antigen-presenting cells.

theme: Lysosomal glycan catabolism and amino-sugar/N-glycan metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are lysosomal degradation of glycosphingolipids and gangliosides (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1 storage disorders), framed here as the catabolic end of a glycan metabolism network that also includes sialic acid, hexosamine and mannose synthesis, N-glycan processing and lysosomal enzyme targeting.

theme: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle positioning
core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome maturation at mitotic entry (recruitment of NuMA and pericentriolar proteins, loss of Nlp, TPX2-dependent Aurora A activation), which here supplies the astral microtubules and spindle assembly needed to position and orient the spindle.

theme: Selective autophagy and clearance of misfolded protein aggregates
core_role: The shared pathways are selective autophagy routes (microautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, aggrephagy, ATG8 delipidation), used here as the degradative disposal arm for misfolded proteins gathered into perinuclear aggresomes.

theme: Regulation of T cell activation, tolerance and Treg differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe the balance of T cell proliferation versus suppression, mainly inhibition of effector CD4/CD8 responses, Th17 commitment and IFN-gamma production with induction of regulatory T cells, set within APC-dependent TCR engagement and co-stimulation.

theme: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and mitochondrial TCA cycle
core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoate-dependent 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage) and their DLD subunit feeding the TCA cycle, framed here as the mitochondrial oxidative core linked to succinate dehydrogenase, iron-sulfur cluster assembly and ATP synthesis.

theme: Heavy metal and zinc homeostasis via transporters and metallothioneins
core_role: The shared pathways concern cellular responses to and detoxification of toxic metals (cadmium, mercury), understood here as handled by the same MTF1-metallothionein and zinc-transporter machinery that maintains zinc and copper homeostasis.

theme: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
core_role: The shared pathways are heme and porphyrin biosynthesis with mitochondrial ABC transport and Fe-S assembly, serving here as hemoglobin production for erythrocytes whose iron uptake, oxygen/CO2 exchange and Rh-mediated ammonium transport make up the rest of the theme.

theme: Cardiac action potential, conduction and calcium-handling excitation-contraction
core_role: The shared pathways describe cardiac electrophysiology, the action potential phases, pacemaker and conduction-system depolarization, HCN channels and intercalated-disc coupling, which here drive the calcium release, K+/Ca2+ channel and exchanger regulation of heart contraction and relaxation.

theme: Biosynthesis of specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators
core_role: The shared pathways are lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoid and lipoxin synthesis and early SPM conjugates, framed here as the pro-resolving branch of inflammatory lipid metabolism together with resolvins, protectins and maresins from omega-3 fatty acids.

theme: Sperm flagellar motility and microtubule-based structure
core_role: The shared pathways concern spermatogenesis and sperm motility, including mitochondrial sheath assembly, flagellar/ciliary beating and Sertoli barrier formation, here supported by kinesin- and microtubule-severing dynamics of the flagellar cytoskeleton.

theme: Amino acid and one-carbon-related catabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways concern alanine metabolism and gluconeogenesis via oxaloacetate, i.e. channelling amino acid carbon into glucose, alongside threonine and choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis as further small-molecule catabolic routes.

theme: Primary cilium assembly, trafficking and disassembly
core_role: The shared pathways cover control of ciliogenesis at the basal body and centriole (centriole elongation, centrosome duplication, basal body docking, cilium assembly and disassembly), the structural cycle within which intraflagellar transport and BBSome cargo targeting build and maintain the cilium.

theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and organic acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/glutamine, proline and aspartate metabolism around 2-oxoglutarate, framed here as the nitrogen-handling hub of amino acid metabolism linked to glycine/glyoxylate metabolism and glycine/glutamine conjugation of xenobiotic acids.

theme: B cell development, activation and proliferation
core_role: The shared pathways are lymphocyte and B cell transcriptional modules for development and activation, read here as markers of the B lineage whose differentiation and proliferation in immune responses the additional terms specify.

theme: Cohesin and condensin-mediated chromosome organization
core_role: The shared pathways are cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion with cohesin-mediated chromatin looping, the cohesion arm of chromosome architecture complementing condensin-driven chromosome condensation and centromere assembly.

theme: NMDA receptor calcium signalling and synaptic plasticity
core_role: The shared pathways are Ca2+/calmodulin kinase cascades (CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV to CREB and AMPK), framed here as the downstream signalling of NMDA-receptor calcium influx that couples glutamatergic activity to long-term potentiation.

theme: N-glycan processing and oligosaccharide/amino-sugar metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glycoside trimming and catabolism, ER N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1 defects) and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown, framed here within broader sugar and amino-sugar metabolism supplying glycan building blocks.

theme: Telomere protection and telomerase-dependent maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways are telomere capping and protection (shelterin-type end protection, blocking NHEJ and recombination/ALT via ATRX-DAXX, restraint of telomerase), which here forms the protective counterpart to telomerase recruitment and C-strand fill-in that lengthen telomeres.

theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation
core_role: The shared pathways name broad organic-acid metabolism in mitochondria and peroxisomes with pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, read here as the peroxisomal/mitochondrial fatty acid catabolism spanning alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation of branched and very long-chain fatty acids.

theme: tRNA and translation-factor modifications ensuring translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA anticodon modifications (t6A, wobble guanine) and aminoacylation that maintain decoding accuracy, framed here together with wybutosine, diphthamide and hydroxylation modifications of tRNA and translation-related proteins.

theme: Amyloid-beta handling and glial activation in neurodegeneration
core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of amyloid-beta production and clearance, tau tangle assembly and microglial/astrocyte activation, i.e. the Alzheimer-type neuroinflammatory and proteinopathy processes that the additional amyloid fibril and clearance terms extend.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA decay
core_role: The shared pathways are pre-mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation, the nuclear 3'-end formation step, read here as the start of an mRNA life cycle that ends in decapping and 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay.

theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and its feedback regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the negative-feedback and attenuation arm of the ERK cascade (RSK activation, phosphatase dephosphorylation, inhibition of Ras and ERK signalling), counterbalancing the RAF activation and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K/NF1 mutant signalling.

theme: FLT3 signalling, oncogenic mutants and TKI resistance
core_role: The shared pathways are FLT3 receptor tyrosine kinase signalling, its STAT5/SRC outputs, CBL-mediated negative regulation and oncogenic FLT3-ITD/fusion activation, framed here as the leukemogenic signal targeted by tyrosine kinase inhibitors to which resistant mutants arise.

theme: Cadherin-based cell-cell adhesion and junctions
core_role: The shared pathways are general cell junction and cell-cell adhesion modules, including apical junctions and their apoptotic cleavage, read here as cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) calcium-dependent adhesion regulated by trafficking and degradation.

theme: GABA synthesis, transport and degradation
core_role: The shared pathways cover GABA synthesis and reuptake/import, the neurotransmitter supply and recycling half of a GABA life cycle completed by its secretion and degradation.

theme: NKT cell and Th1-type IL-12/IFN-gamma immunity
core_role: The shared pathways concern activation, proliferation and differentiation of NKT cells, framed here as innate-like T cell drivers of a Th1 response with IL-12 from activated dendritic cells and IFN-gamma production.

theme: NK and cytotoxic T cell killing and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are cytotoxic effector control (NK degranulation, granzyme-mediated death, protection from NK killing via MHC class Ib and endogenous peptide presentation), i.e. the recognition-and-killing step that NK and CD8 T cells execute and that tolerance mechanisms restrain.

theme: Catecholamine synthesis and transport
core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine synthesis and synaptic catecholamine reuptake regulation, the neurotransmitter production and recycling side of monoamine handling alongside dopamine and norepinephrine transport.

theme: Aromatic and glycine-related amino acid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways concern glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, read here as an end point of amino acid catabolism, with threonine yielding glycine alongside phenylalanine/tyrosine degradation (and phenylketonuria).

theme: Replication stress response and DNA repair regulation
core_role: The shared pathways concern genome-stability control (DNA stability, checkpoint response, deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated repair factors such as FANCD2/PCNA), framed here within responses to replication stress, DNA-protein crosslink and R-loop repair and PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation.

theme: Nitric oxide-cGMP and natriuretic control of blood pressure
core_role: The shared pathways concern cGMP-mediated lowering of blood pressure (vasodilation, natriuresis, diuresis, pulmonary pressure), the systemic vascular and renal output of eNOS-derived NO and guanylyl cyclase signalling that regulates smooth muscle tone.

theme: Translation-associated modifications of tRNA and proteins
core_role: The shared pathways are post-translational hydroxylation of lysine and proline residues, framed here among modifications that support translation (hypusine, diphthamide, tRNA modifications and aminoacylation).

theme: Myeloid innate inflammation and neutrophil degranulation
core_role: The shared pathways are inflammatory and TLR signalling with neutrophil degranulation and complement receptor signalling, the core innate activation program of neutrophils, monocytes and dendritic cells.

theme: Telomere protection and telomerase-dependent maintenance
core_role: The shared pathways are telomere capping and protection against NHEJ and t-circle formation, the end-protection function forming the protective side of telomere maintenance alongside recombination suppression, telomerase recruitment and C-strand synthesis.

theme: Osmoregulation and renal chloride-coupled ion transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular osmotic responses and transepithelial Na+/Cl- transport in the kidney, framed here as cation-chloride cotransporter function whose defects cause Bartter and Gitelman syndromes.

theme: Replication stress response and DNA repair regulation
core_role: The shared pathways concern responses to replication-blocking lesions (hydroxyurea, camptothecin-trapped topoisomerase, DNA-protein crosslinks, R-loops) and origin firing control, set within PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, checkpoint signalling and double-strand break repair choice.

theme: Hypoxia and oxidative stress-induced cell death regulation
core_role: The shared pathways concern modulation of cellular responses to hypoxia and oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed here as stress-induced intrinsic, mitochondria-dependent cell death, for example by hydrogen peroxide or oxygen-glucose deprivation.

theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 cytokine immunity
core_role: The shared pathways are production of IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF, the cytokine signals by which activated dendritic cells and T cells drive Th1 responses and memory T cell differentiation.

theme: Axon guidance and collateral sprouting by netrin signalling
core_role: The shared pathways concern regulation of axon extension, chemorepulsion and collateral branching, here driven by netrin attractive and repulsive signalling in developing sensory and guided axons.

theme: Histone methylation and chromatin remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are histone lysine methylation/demethylation and CHD1/2 chromatin remodellers, framed here among chromatin-modifying complexes (PKMTs, CHD, NuRD, HDACs) controlling heterochromatin and gene expression.
